performance.method: Sequential single process, one active effect, twelve warm 30 Hz update+render samples after 17 percent of duration. CPU cost excludes scene/UI overhead; approximate FPS is a CPU upper bound, not measured presentation FPS.

full_cycle_performance.method: Sequential single process, one active effect, full lifecycle at 30 Hz.

catalog_performance_samples.method: One process, one active effect, warm uncached render at 17/51/97 percent. This prioritization sample excludes update cost and does not establish full lifecycle FPS.

upstream_performance.method: Pinned upstream JS; same 12 update/draw/composite samples and padded front/back canvases as native measurement. No Godot texture upload or scene presentation.

limitations: The other 184 effects have six default lifecycle times plus expanded parameter snapshots for selected optimized effects; complete lifecycle acceptance remains pending.
macOS Godot 4.7.2 only; no new Linux or cross-platform acceptance.
Offline fixed-frame movies do not prove real-time playback performance.

blocked_by.reason: Extreme-parameter and complete actor choreography visual reviews, plus Linux validation, remain pending.

performance.method: Sequential single process, one active effect, twelve warm 30 Hz update+render samples after 17 percent of duration. CPU cost excludes scene/UI overhead; approximate FPS is a CPU upper bound, not measured presentation FPS.

catalog_render_budget.limitation: Three warm render times exclude update and do not establish lifecycle or scene FPS.

visible_realtime.method: Visible GL Compatibility gallery, one active player, no frame cache, actual elapsed-time updates over one complete lifecycle, 60 Hz scene cap and 30 Hz effect render target. Includes UI/scene scheduling; screenshots are runtime output, not oracle references.

native_visual.limitation: Fixed-frame recording; parameter extremes and complete actor choreography movies remain pending.

delivery.reason: User requested delivery and an end to repeated acceptance runs.
delivery.evidence_scope: Top-level source/artifact hashes and results describe the last completed snapshot. Delivery hashes identify the later code; targeted diamond and performance probes completed, but the 119-effect expanded rerun was stopped and is not a pass.
